comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Comes from recipe via Anita (Town's man recipe) in Florence.

Recipe Name : "Making Fine Orb"
Skill Requirements : Handicraft Rank 17
Need 1200 Handicrafts Contribution.

Materials : 3x High-grade Emerald + 5x Highest-grade Amethyst + 10x High-grade Platinum

Stats :
Durability 30/30
Formality 70
+1 Cooking
Total Fame Required 5000

Part of Processed Gemstones (No.1) Memorial Album.

wiki:
Item for Processed Gemstones (No.1) Memorial Album

Mini-Guide (courtesy of Papaya support ticket):

To unlock the recipe for this item, you must have a specific amount of Cultural Contribution Points.

Cultural Contribution Points Necessary: 30,000

Important! If you still do not have access, you will have to talk to the Lorenzo de Medici NPC in the Florence Palace when you have over 10,000 Cultural Contribution Points so you can start the Event to unlock the Recipes.

?After doing this and talking to Anita in the same palace, you should be able to find the Recipe.
